decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The out building, being 4.2m deep and 7m wide, with a mono-pitched roof with a maximum height of 3m, that takes the total area of outbuilding and extension coverage to approximately 24% of the dwellings curtilage, as shown on the plans received on the 6th July 2004 constitutes permitted development as defined by Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended) and therefore does not require planning permission.

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE 

The detached out building hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 78 Munster Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or separate habitable or business unit).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey detached store/shed to rear of dwellinghouse.
